groups.title: Required Courses
groups.note: Required courses taken at CEGEP or elsewhere that are not credited toward the B.A. & Sc. must be replaced by approved complementary courses. Regardless of the substitution, students must take at least 18 credits in this program. Students who have already taken CHEM 212 or its equivalent will choose another appropriate complementary course, to be approved by the adviser.

rules.title: Any 3-credit biology course at the 300 level or higher approved by the Biology Adviser
